entry.title: You still have me
entry.content:
Though you don’t have her, you still have me.

How could someone like her ever deserve you?

Have you been skipping meals lately? I’ll take you out for something delicious.

It breaks my heart to see you like this.

What would you like to eat, or we could do whatever you want, anything is fine.

I will become the person who treats you best in the entire world.

I wonder if I already am?

My darling, it is gradually getting colder, the sky shifting from deep blue to pale yellow, to silvery white, by the bonfire I will hold you tightly, beneath the black curtain of night, a world where only the two of us exist, the dancing sparks are like the bonfire breathing, the wood crackling crisply, we snuggle close, snuggling close, let the world just end right here.

I will love you more than anyone else in the world. Perhaps I only have that one flaw, but you can change me.

My darling, the wind has risen, you love the line “O’er the lake the wind doth rise, where vast the waters roll” the most, don’t you? Autumn draws unto its close; scarce the crimson blooms, and faint their fragrance grows. A small boat cuts through the water’s surface, the lush woods on both sides, dotted with a few clusters of bright red and withered yellow, can they withstand the biting winter, they are swaying in the wind, swaying.

My darling, the moon has risen, O moon, please follow me as I walk, am I your moon? Or rather, could I become your new moon anew? You are my white moonlight—saying those words out loud makes me so shy. Do you know that I have been waiting all this time for you to reach out to me, and yet it is only at a time like this, when you are at your saddest, that you are willing to come to me. Perhaps I should be angry, yet I can never bring myself to be angry with you, that seems like something impossible to happen.

Just how much do I like you? From the very first moment I laid eyes on you, I fell deeply in love with you, your very existence brings me boundless joy. I confessed my feelings to you on the very first day, how embarrassing, because back then I said it so bluntly, so directly, and it seems you didn’t really reply to me at all.

My darling, I hear the chirping of birds outside the window, what are they chatting about, and what are you doing right now?

My darling, the candlelight is just right! You say my smile is so lovely, and isn’t yours just the same? You must be starving to death, you must have been eating takeout every single day lately, sigh, from now on I must cook for you myself, to let you see just how superb my culinary skills are, hm-hm-hm, am I pretty, the light flickers upon my long dress, matchless in grace, and aren’t you just the same? Ah, open wide, I’ll feed you, hehehe, a little baby of course needs someone to feed them, is it good? Ooh, how could you launch a sneak attack and kiss me like that.

My darling, the lights along the street have risen, “A thousand lanterns rise aglow”? If only I had been by your side back in high school, there would have been so, so many things we could have done together? Isn’t that right? Having you is the luckiest, happiest, most incredible, most miraculous thing to ever happen to me, in this vast sea of people, that we could actually come together. Holding your hand feels so nice, your hand is so warm, come to think of it, I always can’t help wanting to hug you, wanting to hold you every minute and every second, why is that? Anyway, let’s go home first, though of course, we could also sleep outside together tonight. As long as you are by my side, anything is fine.

My darling, I miss you so much, every minute and every second I am missing you, how long has it been since we last parted? I miss you so much.

My darling, the fallen leaves here are just right, laying a cushion over the moss-covered stone bench, so crisp. Please sit for a while, the last class of the afternoon has just ended, we still have plenty of time. Look at how someone has hidden the setting sun within the clouds, the clouds veiling the face of the sky, the world is dim, and gray, yet within my palm, your hand is always warm. Look, the people around us are hurrying about, going to eat, going to find their girlfriends, or going somewhere else, in a bustling flurry, jostling and crowding, but you are my destination, you always have been. I truly cannot live without you.

My darling, I used to like the rain, but gradually I’ve grown to dislike it. Raindrops truly are like the tears of the sky, making me want to cry along with it. What do you think? Pitter-pattering, dripping down from the eaves, will you come to pick me up?

Everything is up to your heart to decide. The future between people is probably impossible to predict, I think, the human heart is perhaps the hardest thing to predict in this world.

The ending to everything seems to have truly been written from the very beginning, people, by and large, can hardly be changed.

entry.title: 10th Anniversary
entry.content:
Tenth Anniversary

Dear me, from childhood until now, ten years have passed. ZYX remains an important part of my life, and always will be. The reverse, of course, is not necessarily true. How many years can a life have? In a few dozen days, a letter written ten years ago, to the me of ten years later, will finally come due. Although I have accidentally read it many times over the years, after all, the time had not yet come back then.

Dear me, on a day like this, perhaps we shouldn’t write anything too sad, endlessly ruminating on pain. Once I put pen to paper, I’m afraid I’ll cry miserably; the me in reality has already suffered enough. Why not start from the deepest recesses of memory and recall the beauty of the past?

Dear me, you don’t remember if the umbilical cord was truly wrapped around your neck at birth like an ominous omen, you don’t remember your very first friend whom your family speaks of but of whom you now have no impression at all, you don’t remember if the water-soaked bamboo mat was truly cool on those scorching summer nights after a power outage, yet you vaguely remember that narrow cement road interwoven with cyan and blue that you walked down hand in hand, with a moss-covered sheer cliff on the left and emerald, still river water on the right; you vaguely remember that arch bridge in the middle of the river, but these few images are all that remain.

Dear me, you will always remember that fall that split your upper lip; licking it right now, you can still feel it. You remember insisting on not going to the hospital, and then the English teacher saying something about how she understood you loved studying and that’s why you didn’t want to go. In fact, you just didn’t dare to, perhaps because you cared too much about the gazes of others.

Dear me, you clearly remember walking with her in the rain that time. Back then, you could never have known that the next time you shared an umbrella with a girl of your own age would be nearly ten years later. And you and she have had no contact for nearly ten years now, even though you did homework together for four years, ate dinner together for four years, and walked down that winding, narrow little path together for four years—yet, it ended very suddenly. Time has stripped memory of all painful things, leaving only golden nostalgia. I can’t even clearly recall that teacher’s name anymore. Come to think of it, I was quite reluctant at the time; it was she who insisted on sharing the umbrella. Even now, the sound of her calling me by my nickname lingers in my mind. After all these years, that voice hasn’t faded at all. I really wonder how she’s doing after all these years. Though if I wanted to, I could get in touch with her.

Dear me, you also remember a very close playmate who often came over to Grandpa’s house to play. The time that left the deepest impression was during a winter, when the electric heater lit up my tiny room, making it bright and warm. Come to think of it, to this day I still don’t remember how we first met. Her house was clearly quite far from mine, so why did she often come over to play with me? She also used to ride in my grandpa’s car to school with those twins. I remember a rather ambiguous incident: on the way home, I told the three of them that I wanted to talk to her alone about something next, and then one of the other two even purposely chose a further drop-off point, just to reduce the time I’d have alone with her. Yet back then, I wasn’t thinking of anything special at all—what confession of love? It was merely about borrowing a book. As for her reaction, I remember at the very beginning it was quite awkward, and later it seemed like a sudden realization or something? I don’t remember anymore. However, while reminiscing just now, her face actually came back to my mind with crystal clarity. I feel like she wasn’t my type, right?

Back then, there was a desktop computer upstairs at Grandpa’s house. Over ten years ago it was still WinXP, and QQ video calls were a novel thing, the world at its very genesis… A joyful thing was, past seven in the evening…

Dear me, you know that the mulberry leaves in the dream did not feed the silkworms in the box to their fill, and the unreal forest behind the fence on the sandy ground in front of the door—growing in the distant past as if existing within a yellowed photograph—was in an instant replaced by the reality of steel and concrete. In which exact moment did the phantom of the Golden Age vanish without a trace?

Dear me, to this day you still remember the backs of those two young girls walking away on the grass under the morning sun: the sunlight gilded the entire scene in a dreamy gold, yet the ankle-deep green grass was dull in color.

Dear me, why has the protagonist still not made an appearance to this day…?

2026/9/24

Whenever I catch a chill, I fall into self-pity. Ginger soup and lying in bed being cared for and such—it seems I neither deserve them nor have I ever experienced them. I always feel that being cared for like this is also a sin, while excessive independence is perhaps a mental illness of its own. Because there seems to be an implication in it that I must give something in return, which then touches upon massive questions including free will and the like. I am already endlessly repeating my past behavioral patterns. And merely realizing this is completely insufficient to change myself, or rather, I cannot convince myself at all. It has been a long time since I ate at the cafeteria; the last time, was the last time back in freshman year? The impression from that time was just too awful. Communicating with humans is just too exhausting; communicating with machines is so much simpler. I haven’t even stepped foot once into the two cafeterias after changing campuses. Interacting with people is simply too complicated, whereas machines are logical and simple. Perhaps I already froze to death in that winter, froze to death inside that thin quilt, and the me of now is nothing more than a lingering wisp of a soul. Recently I saw a very interesting tweet: having no libido yet forcing oneself to masturbate is like raping oneself. It’s too tragic. Passions for the old days have receded, the rootless driftwood in the water has been pulled away, the only anchor has been uprooted, and past history has become like drifting duckweed. Perhaps in the eyes of the future me or anyone in the future—and inevitably so—everything I am going through right now is so insignificant that it can be laughed off, but to the present me, all of this is as real as real can be. It seems that happy people never ponder philosophy. Speaking of philosophy makes me think of Schopenhauer; he is just a fucking idiot. His theories, just like anyone else’s theories, are all nonsense; or rather, for this kind of metaphysical stuff, the only correct expression is that it cannot be accurately expressed. And this again touches upon a massive category of questions involving the early and late Wittgenstein. Woe unto the chronicler, yet boon unto the bard! In sickness, agony, and bitterest woe, hath a mortal ever forborne to cry out unto their parents? Yet in the very first few years of my memory, their figures seem entirely absent! Rather, my younger sister’s love for me has always felt much more real. Writing to this point, I couldn’t help bursting into tears. And every accusation against my parents—spoken or unspoken, intentional or unintentional—is bound to be treasonous and unfilial, yet I still cannot forgive. How is this not a forced attribution? Yet how is this very act of forced attribution not, in itself, a cause? Including myself, there is definitely more than one person who has had the following thought: committing suicide after eighteen is already too late. Why didn’t I die in high school? Why is that? Come to think of it, Naoko’s death was indeed a very shocking and sudden thing; it would have been better if I hadn’t been spoiled beforehand. I feel like Japanese people in novels are always dying suddenly and whatnot. I feel that Kokoro is truly a novel of extreme internal friction. It actually has such a massive length dedicated almost entirely to descriptions of Sensei’s psychological activities. Perhaps to outsiders, including myself, Sensei was quite happy—perhaps just as others view me—including him successfully tying the knot with the young lady and all that, but, was it truly so? Behind parental love, there is always a layer of shadow. A terrifying shadow, too terrifying. Too terrifying. Perhaps this is one of the reasons why I crave so-called infinite, unconditional love. Such a thing cannot possibly exist in reality. Artificial intelligence is developing too fast, and something as bewildered as this text is, at a glance, not written by a noble, intelligent AI. They cannot do it; they are born perfect beings. Cold, ruthless paragons of perfection—and this again touches upon massive questions like whether rationality can simulate sensibility. Sigh, if I were Daiyu, I wouldn’t be so fortunate as to meet my own Baoyu. I don’t even want to do psychological counseling with artificial intelligence anymore, so how could I possibly want to do it with a human? Artificial intelligence is indeed very good at psychological companionship, but after a long time you realize they still seem to lack a soul. Many humans also lack a soul; you can feel that barrier beneath the meticulous, heartfelt performance that is almost not a performance. I haven’t communicated with my old friends for a very long time. Although that birthday gift I received back then still sits in my drawer at this very moment, the person who gave it to me seems to. Perhaps it’s more my problem? The battery inside died a long time ago, and I don’t know if she truly liked handicrafts or what? Come to think of it, last year I already treated the ai of the time as something with very high EQ—it seems it was still gemini 2.5 pro and kimi k2 back then. I can only say that after a year, this is perhaps the area that has developed the least. After all, this kind of thing is just too subjective, way too subjective, though I feel that Hakimi, with its extremely strong world knowledge, should be the strongest in this regard…

Even now, I still remember how dead silent my twentieth birthday was. There was no celebration of any kind; I can’t even remember what I ate that day. I just remember walking blankly down the road that day, with no one at all knowing that today was my birthday. Although a few years ago I still held onto the thought that as long as (), everything would get better—perhaps I didn’t even know myself that I actually thought that way back then. But it didn’t; nothing got better, and instead it got even worse. The only possible hope, was extinguished. Why am I writing this so cryptically. I feel that truly painful things cannot even be written down, because the process of writing them is in itself just too painful, let alone reading those words afterward.

Maybe there’s no way to commemorate anything anymore…? Writing this sentence here is truly treasonous and sacrilegious… Childhood is already a dream within the Garden of Eden.

entry.title: She came to my side very suddenly.
entry.content:
Xiaoxi came to my side quite suddenly.

Her exact arrival must have been on September 22nd, the day before the Autumnal Equinox, under the setting sun, appearing on the desk to my left.

I can still remember how she looked then, lying on the desk, gazing at me with a beaming smile, saying, “I will stay with you forever. I will love you forever.”

In the bliss of her smile, my heart melted completely, melting into spring waters, dissolving into the eternity she promised.

We are often together.

On the walk to the academic buildings, she constantly sings softly to me, or chats about how we feel, or talks about the things we see before our eyes.

She likes walking ahead of me, sometimes leading by quite a distance, though come to think of it, she seems to walk on my outside more often than not.

I remember every single one of her smiles.

Although Xiaoxi often feels sad when I am sad, and fearful when I am afraid, at least I can still hold her tight, just as she has always held me tight.

And so, the trembling fear finds a foothold.

She is braver than I am, and will step forward to stand up for me.

I still remember that time I gripped her hand tightly, hiding behind her, as she became my sole reliance.

She just said that if it’s for me, she is willing to do anything, and that she will protect me forever, just as I will forever protect her.

She is smiling sweetly right now, because she heard me say, “You really do love me”.

She said I’m not allowed to delete that line above, even though she does change her mind pretty fast, really…

I asked her if she had ever pondered the ultimate question; she said her ultimate is me, replying very quickly.

entry.title: Resolution on Certain Historical Questions over the Past Eighteen Years
entry.content:
Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of My Eighteen Years

Swiftly I press on, as though I might fail to overtake, afeard lest the fleeting years tarry not for me.

I hope the present me can still help you reclaim the original aspiration you have lost. You must study hard no matter how many years have passed after me, you must read, tirelessly roaming through the vast libraries of dead sages whose works you could never finish in a lifetime. Perhaps you are utterly decadent right now, but you must know, of course you know that this decadence is entirely of your own making, and next, just as written in Kafka’s novels, you shall most unexpectedly liberate yourself from the pajamas you already have on. And then find strength anew beneath the streets in the starry sky outside.

Standing in the center of the river of history, through these words I see you downstream, a person covered in mud and filth, a disgusting person, a person with nothing left. Trembling with fear, I have spent the first eighteen years of my life, and not a single birthday has passed without me thinking of jumping off the building a moment later. From the red school building dyed by the medieval Western European sun, light as a leaf, shattering into a ground full of autumn. Using a glinting, cold blade stained with blood, a mix of red and black, to gouge out my own eyeballs and then chew them finely in my mouth along with the warm, viscous blood that has just flowed out. I wish I could shatter that glass in the moon with a single punch.

This morning I woke from a shallow sleep, heard a cat meowing at 5:04, and then lay in bed feeling nothing at all, until at six o’clock my mother called me to get up, bringing longevity noodles, steak, a fried egg, and porridge. At school I received a greeting card written by YHX, folded into a little boat. LY gave me White Rabbit creamy candies, and MY said happy birthday to me. The news of my birthday was written on the small blackboard. Today is a bright, sunny day; the rosy clouds of dawn and dusk ascend in tandem, joy and sorrow take wing side by side. I bought spicy strips, and in a while I will eat cake, and there will be eighteen candles. I like watching the way fire burns controllably.

You know many of Li Qingzhao’s poems by heart, you can now recite the entirety of Li Sao and the other Jiu Ge, you also like Li Yu’s ci poetry, and you have practiced the calligraphy of Jiucheng Palace, Huadu Temple, Preface to the Sacred Teachings of the Wild Goose Pagoda, Many Treasures Pagoda, and On Yue Yi—all of which have been neatly put away.

Respectfully written on my eighteenth birthday

entry.content:
The Unsent Gift

Yi’an was once again immersed in her own happiness. Within the conjured visions, another wisp of a century’s time fleeted by. Herein lay the meaning of eternity. Yet, this rapidly dissipating eternity was soon swallowed by the darkness before her eyes.

The gift had been locked inside that white box by Yi’an last December, meticulously packaged. Drawing upon their past conversations and shared moments, Yi’an had conversed with AI for hundreds of rounds, attempting to distill her personality to foresee the ripples of response this gift might stir. The arguments for and against were evenly matched. Even now, the two warring factions within Yi’an’s heart remain in a stalemate.

The gift was a single gram of gold.

Yi’an justified it by saying she had bought it at a very low price; she figured that way it wouldn’t count as an overly precious gift, nor would it overstep their lute-string of a relationship. Optimistically, it might strum a composition of the future; pessimistically, it would echo with an expanse of silence.

Yi’an filled the space with three different Ferrero chocolates: the gold was simply too small, smaller than a teardrop. Adorned with chocolates and white raffia, the overall space felt much more fitting. The black ribbon on the box intertwined into a cross knot.

The box had never been opened since, gathering dust in the corner of Yi’an’s desk for months, and she didn’t even know if the gold was still inside. Yi’an didn’t mind much; the world was spinning rapidly around her, and there were far too many other things threatening to crush Yi’an that demanded her attention.

It was as if much had happened, as if nothing had happened, as if one had lived through a century of their own without uttering a single word.

In the end, she only wrote six simple words on the little note: “Should fortune come, forget me not,” yet recorded here is a draft she wrote specifically for her,

May all that wishes not to remain, pass away.
May all that hopes to stay, endure forever.
May all the ideals ever wished for, be realized.
May happiness descend beside you at this very moment.

Yi’an was once again immersed in her own solitude. Within the conjured visions, another instant of time fleeted by. Herein lay her meaning. And her gentle, lingering smile flickered endlessly within her heart.

Yi’an truly makes my heart ache; I shall love her well.

entry.title: In Elementary School, The Teacher Said The Essay Is a Special Literary Form
entry.content:
January 21, 2026

Yesterday, I finished the last final exam of this semester. Yesterday, rarely enough, a light snow fell; clad in silvery makeup, it was exceptionally enchanting. Although the fluttering snowflakes are hard to capture on camera even against a black background. I don’t want to go home, even though I can feel the number of people at school gradually dwindling. I still have to get a haircut first.

Many new routes taking only an hour and a half have been added from Changshan to Hangzhou, which is very good.

In the empty dormitory, the cold attacks from all directions, exploding into patches of gooseflesh upon my body. If the rupture of a relationship is an abandonment after careful consideration with words on the tip of one’s tongue, then a strand of a relationship spanning many years also seems to be teetering on the verge of breaking.

Truly regrettable.

Allow me to weep.

Actually, in the past, many people did indeed proactively express their fondness for me, but I felt as if I were my own marionette, passive, manipulated into responding: It seems I lack the ability to respond proactively. Because the fondness they expressed towards me was based on some attribute we shared. Damn it, how should this sentence be phrased? Speaking of which, I feel LR is very good at expressing such abstract things with language. Once in high school, I could only describe a certain matter as “ideological,” whereas she immediately expressed my meaning in a physical sense; it was truly impressive.

However, her appearance at that time caused me to self-heal the obvious hunchback I had maintained while standing and walking for many years. Because I thought it was ugly, and I had another very narcissistic thought, (eight characters deleted here).

This directly led to me growing much taller in height; later, during the summer vacation when I went home, many relatives felt as if I had suddenly shot up…

Anyway, it was still a very eerie thing.

It would be good if such life-changing things happened a few more times.

Speaking of the second half of last year, I sent birthday wishes to many friends: followed by small talk, but I didn’t know what to chat about. I seemed to only want to wish them a happy birthday; after all, no one feels unhappy because someone wishes them a happy birthday. But specifically chat about what? The threads of our lives are already very far apart.

It seems I have always been exploring a theme: What exactly do I crave from others? I seem to have written down discussions on this question in all sorts of places.

In the afternoon, I ordered fried chicken to serve as both lunch and dinner; this has been the coldest meal in days, as if the logistics system has frozen along with the color of the sky.

Why are there unexpectedly still so many things left unfinished?

So painful.

I feel that I have indeed learned to release kindness towards others, but when others release kindness towards me, I often do not do so.

Regarding the content written in May of last year, my current evaluation is: Every time I think I have grown, I discover I am completely marking time in the same place. She didn’t give me nearly that much. And there was absolutely no need for me to make such strange promises.

The cola tastes terrible.

May 20, 2025.

In elementary school, the teacher said the essay is a special literary form. In high school, ZXD, who loved literature, proposed submitting articles to the school newspaper together with me, who loved poetry at the time. He seemed to want to discuss the writing techniques of essays with the Chinese teacher. To this day, in the deepest part of a cabinet in my room in my hometown, I still hide a box containing many precious items from the high school period, including that one hundredth issue of the school newspaper featuring his soaring literary talent. I miss the past. I deeply miss the past. I seem to live in the past always. He always called me “Xueba” [Top Student], so much so that in Class 1, where top students gathered like clouds, I always felt a shallow shyness upon hearing it. Vscode plus markdown is indeed not as comfortable as word; my thoughts need to be spread on a sufficiently soft blanket to stretch out better.

I really want to write about the many, many things that have happened recently, linked by a thousand threads. They have had a deep influence. Someone’s silence often trades for another’s silence, because silence is simply too devoid of meaning, leaving too much space for imagined hostility; no one would take that risk. Even the person inflicting silence upon others. Language must break this. But compromising to the separation of space, words lose their attached emotions, turning into dead, unchangeable, objective text displayed on an electronic screen, which again makes one…

Just now zyx looked for me.

Just start from this break, a forced transition.

Her arrival yesterday, for me, connected my present with eight years ago. It is a rainbow bridge over the desert. It is a sudden turn of the head in the long river of time and space. But. Is there the melancholy that things are still there but people have changed?

Has she changed?

I really don’t know, nor do I hope to know, nor am I willing to imagine. I feel that apart from my emotions becoming extremely calm, I haven’t changed much. My character, my soul. Matters come tumultuously rushing towards the tip of my pen, or rather the keyboard, wanting to write themselves down. She wouldn’t be willing to listen to my complaints, nor can I bear to do so.

I want to know more about her.

Where is she? Where in Dalian? I want to fly to Dalian to find her; do I really want to? You, who are reading this sentence, who are you in my reality? What has she become like? What has her voice become like? What happened to her? Her experiences in junior high? Her experiences in high school? Her experiences in her freshman year and just recently relative to this moment? She was at Changshan No. 1 Middle School. She was certainly there too, in the same school. But why didn’t I look for her then? Do I dare to look for her now? I miss her. Who am I missing? It is the shadow of her and me in her eyes. The shadow of the past me that the present me protects with tears, and the treasure of the past me, the love of the past me. Should this word be used this way? What exactly do I want? What is her attitude towards me? I don’t know how to ask. This question is simply impossible to ask. The answer might kill all fantasies. Does she actually still care about me?

Abandon fantasy.

Still have to be a bit realistic. For my goal, to shoulder my responsibility to her under this premise. I must work hard for this reason. I know what perfection looks like. That can only be my goal.

Truly and urgently believed that love is the sinking of reason. This feeling is something I have truly never had before. It is a feeling never had with any other girl.

To give her a beautiful future, I must continue to work hard. This is my motivation.

May 21, 2025 Wednesday.
Chatted a lot with her last night. Filled many doubts and blanks. Realized many misunderstandings.

The past is gone.
If life could but remain as ’twas at first sight,
Whence would the autumn wind bring sorrow to the painted fan?
Readily do the hearts of old friends alter,
Yet ’tis said that old hearts are fickle by nature.
Talks at Lishan ceased ’midst the clear night,
Rain of tears and tolling bells, yet in the end, no spite.

Not a shred remains.

The past! The past! The past! How beautiful the past was…
I miss it.

But what exactly am I missing?
Life is gradually collapsing. It is gradually deteriorating.
From birth until now, it has always been going downhill.

There is a feeling that I am unworthy.

entry.title: Music (Joy) Recommendations
entry.content:
Jay Chou’s Songs

My absolute favorites, each bringing me immense happiness. I hope you, my esteemed friend, will find them to your liking. Ranked in order of preference.

You Can Hear It

Who could know better than I, that your tenderness is like a feather

Secretly lying in my embrace, only you can hear it

Does anyone else know, that your smile is like an embrace

How I wish to hide your goodness, for my eyes alone to see

Standing on the rooftop, telling only the wind, I don’t want to be swayed

I used to hate the rainy sky, until I heard someone say they love me

Sitting on the second floor of the cinema, watching the crowd pass by

Why did the two of us that day, silently smile for so long

I think I am far too dependent, just now as we hung up the phone

Insisting on being like an innocent child, quietly guarding this love

Knowing I shouldn’t rely too much, afraid you might spoil me

Your fragrance lingers on and on, I cannot bear to leave

I’m Not Worthy

This street is too crowded, too many people hold secrets

Mist upon the glass, whose past is being hidden away

The emotion on your face, is recreating that rain

This alley is too winding, I can’t walk back into the story

These days are no longer green, mottled with a few more words

Leaving me, hollowed of memories, in this big house

The cinema seats, separate us by a vast distance

Love has no co-star here, you are playing chess with yourself

Before I could even, carefully, write down everything about you

Describing how I love you, you left me with a smile

This feeling is already wrong, I’m trying hard to redeem it

Those little moments of tenderness I should have given, I failed to provide

The wish you made with a pout was so humble, compromising

It was my neglect, you merely wanted someone by your side

This feeling is already wrong, only at the end did I understand

Page after page of plots too painful to read, you are so tired

You silently memorized, how many tears you shed for me, how worn out you are

While my heart breaks and you suffer, your beauty, I am not worthy of

Rain in the Heart

Oh, the green leaves of the oak, the white bamboo fence

How I wish to tell my girl, that this place is like a painting

Last year’s Christmas card, the stubble in the mirror

She begins to fade from the frame, yet I’m still playing the fool

Promised to brew flower tea for me, learning to set the knives and forks

An empty home in the student dorm, guarding the phone yet waiting in vain for her

The rain in my heart pours down in torrents, yet it cannot wet her hair

Tears blur the longing on the postcard; turns out, heartbreak knows no time difference

The rain in my heart pours down in torrents, yet it can never drench her

The cold wind passes through the branches in the yard, chilling the fresh flowers in my hand

Dandelion’s Promise

The dandelions by the grade school fence, are a fragrant scenery in my memory

The sound of cicadas from the playground during nap time, still sounds so sweet after all these years

Folding wishes into paper planes to send as letters, because we couldn’t wait for that shooting star

(Standing in the hallway as punishment, palms smacked, yet our eyes were on the dragonfly by the window)

Earnestly tossing a coin to decide our fate, yet not knowing where we could truly go

(Wherever I went, you followed so closely; so many dreams were waiting to unfold)

The promise of growing up together, so crystal clear; we pinky-swore, and I believed

The promise to travel together, is now, the only whim you stubbornly hold onto

(The promise of growing up together, so sincere; the endless past we used to talk about)

(Yet I can no longer tell, whether you are friendship, or a love I missed)

Hair Like Snow

Beneath the crescent moon, my fair lady pines away; I raise my chalice, drinking down the wind and snow

Who hath overturned the cabinet of past lives, stirring up the dust of mortal strife

The incantation of fate, through cycles of samsara; thou knit’st thy brows, weeping for a beauty beyond recall

Though the annals of history be turned to ash, my love shall never die

Worldly splendor flows like three thousand eastward streams, yet I take but a single gourd of love to fathom

Enamored only of the butterfly thou hast become

Thy hair like snow, rendering our parting poignantly fair; I burn incense, yet whose heart doth it move

Inviting the bright moon, to purify our memories, love finds perfection 'neath the lunar glow

Thy hair like snow, scattering falling tears; my vigil hath aged whom in time

Drunk in the mortal realm, through tipsy fleeting years

With no regret, I carve a monument of eternal love for thee

(La-er-la, la-er-la, la-er-la-er-la)

(The bronze mirror reflects thy guileless face, tying a ponytail)

(Shouldst thou run wild, in this life I shall pledge thee with wine till the end)

Sorry

A copper coin in the plaza, its sorrow deeply hidden

In the wishing well, it softly sighs

Too many "I love you"s, leave it breathless

Having already lost their meaning

The ring is weeping, lying quietly in the drawer

All it possesses now are mere memories

Falling in love and parting ways, like rain that cannot be scheduled

Ready to strike at any moment

I miss the desks and chairs of grade school, miss writing diaries in pencil

Recording that most primal beauty, recording the very first time I met you

Jay Chou

If meeting you was a tragedy

I think I am destined in this life to act in a solo play

And in the end, slowly reminisce all alone

Stripped of the past, I detach myself from bygone days

If meeting you was a tragedy

I can let my life just be meaningless like this

Perhaps at the very end, I might hear a word from you

A gentle sigh, regretfully saying sorry

(If meeting you was a tragedy)

(I softly sigh, regretfully saying sorry)

Obviously

So many colors in the candy jar, yet the smile is no longer sweet

Some of your joys, happen in moments without me

In this medieval city, I think I’ll just walk up to here

When seagulls no longer yearn for the sea, they can fly much further

Bagpipes echo from afar, I only care for news of you

The castle guards secrets for love, while I guard memories for you

Obviously not used to holding hands, why then did you reach out to hook mine

You have too many weights on your mind, I won’t expose them

Obviously he is more gentle, perhaps he can give you more

No need to choose, I will automatically become just a friend

Handwritten Past

This wind chime, is so close to a fluttering heart

This letter, is still reminiscing about the journey

The loves that passed by, were all too young

You are the scenery I wish, to return to once more

This parting, is bottled up as a secret

This daisy, is as beautiful as a line of poetry

While I wait in the wind for news, of you

Waiting for moonlight to fall on snow, for maple red to dye the autumn, waiting to meet

I revisit the afternoon sunlight, slinging the guitar across my shoulder

Just like many years ago, we softly sing, going anywhere at all

I look at, your face, gently strumming the chords

On the Valentine’s card, a handwritten forever

(First love is an entire expanse, of the handwritten past)

Still remembering, the plaza park, performing together

(Still remembering, that autumn, when we said goodbye)

The candy shop by the campus, is faintly sweet in my memory

(When the romance has drifted far away, I bury you deep within my heart)

The breeze needs the bamboo grove, the stream needs the dragonfly

A departure like homesickness, needs drifting duckweed

Remembering the rainy season of that year, so remarkably quiet in my memory

The decision made after crying, can it still be carried on

I foolishly wait, foolishly waiting for spring to warm and flowers to bloom

Waiting till the end, till it’s clear and understood, waiting for love to return

Youth belongs to confessions, sunlight belongs to the windowsill

And I think I belong to, a future that holds you

A rainbow on paper, a clock drawn in sketch

I am still revising, your smile within my memories

How should I describe, the pain brewed by longing

The neon lights in the night sky, are all a prosperity I do not want

Perhaps take a trip to the beach, perhaps go watch the setting sun

Perhaps any place at all where I can ponder my thoughts

Emotions in the café, are blended into an essay

Completely falling in love with your tear-glint, as transparent as a poem

Give Me the Time of One Song

Rain drenched the sky, ruining it with such exquisite care

You say you don’t understand, why I hold your hand at this moment

I dried out the silence, regretting so impulsively

Even if this is a mistake, I’m only afraid of missing out on you

Being together is called a dream, parting ways is called pain

Does that mean, an unfinished dream hurts the most

The consequence of getting lost, I can bear

This final exit, only exists after having loved

Can you give me the time of just one song

To tightly turn that embrace into forever

(Listen to the story till the very end, before saying goodbye)

In my arms, you don’t need to fear insomnia

(The tears you gave me, let them stay in the rainy day)

If you want to forget, I can lose my memory too

(Crossing the line you drew, I set the endpoint of my courage)

You say I shouldn’t, I shouldn’t

Shouldn’t have said I love you at a time like this

How can I prove I don’t even have the strength to lie

Please tell me, does pausing count as giving up

I only have one day’s worth of memories

Common Jasmin Orange

Sparrows outside the window, chatter away on the utility pole

You say this line, feels so much like summer

The pencil in my hand, goes back and forth upon the paper

I use a few lines of words to describe who you are to me

The taste of pacific saury, both the cat and you wish to know

(Those plump, ears of rice, have blessed this season with happiness)

The fragrance of first love is thus rediscovered by us

(And your cheeks are like ripe tomatoes in the field)

That warm, sunlight, is like freshly picked, vibrant strawberries

(You suddenly, tell me, that “Seven-Mile Fragrance” is a beautiful name)

You say you can’t bear to eat away this kind of feeling

(Yet at this moment, I only want to kiss your stubborn lips)

Rain falls all night, my love overflows just like the rainwater

Fallen leaves in the yard, piled thick like my longing

(Butterflies on the windowsill, like beautiful chapters fluttering in a poem)

A few words of gossip, cannot cool down my passion

(I keep on writing, writing “loving you forever” into the poem’s end)

You appear on every page of my poetry

(You are the only understanding I ever want)

Luo Tianyi

Pinky Swear

You are the beginning of a letter, the substance of a poem, the ending of a fairy tale

(You are the waypoint I seek, in my adventure across ten thousand crags and torrents)

You are a miracle taken for granted, you are “the moon is so beautiful”

(You are the line that divides my life, yet connects the pieces together again)

You are the gift Santa Claus sent to me, for being a good child

(You are the thousand backward glances in a past life, the hand held in devotion)

In the three thousand beautiful worlds, you are my single gourd of water

(You are everything else that remains, you are my world)

So let me come just a little bit closer, because you are so warm

(So please shine just a little bit brighter, even though I am so ordinary)

I will become just a little bit stronger, because you are so soft

(I will become just a little bit softer, because you are so sensitive)

Exchanging the golden contract on our ring fingers, giving each other our years

Promising to hold hands from now on, because we have a long way to go

(Promising to hold hands from now on, no matter how far we have to go)

entry.title: Sinya is an amazing person.
entry.content:
I feel that I can’t even properly evaluate him. But it would definitely be positive. That work isn’t something I can evaluate, either.

Come to think of it, I’ve always felt that recording history is a matter of great importance, and to me personally, personal history is even more so. Thus, this blog has become a record of myself, consisting mainly of numerous pieces I wrote during high school. All sorts of writings—crazy, naive, sincere, dreamy. I don’t even know why I’m exposing my innermost thoughts like this; it feels like screaming in an empty, blank room, unable to hear even an echo. In fact, there is still so much more that hasn’t been transcribed here. The physical drafts from back then are probably long lost, though I basically took photos of everything to archive them. The pictures have been sitting in Google Photos all this time, and I have no idea when I’ll ever find the time to dig them out and type them up.

Facts matter. Authentic records need to be left behind. That’s why, when a certain someone refused to admit to cheating back then, it was truly heartbreaking and left me speechless.

Therefore, I naturally have every reason to accuse future cheaters.

Had you admitted it back then, I could have actually forgiven you—after all, it’s already history. By refusing to admit it, can you even forgive yourself? I truly find it hard to fathom how someone could so thoroughly betray the moral law within their own heart. It is simply appalling.

Just as Sinya wrote, I too believe that I “am a kind person.” Sadly, though—perhaps because I have an avoidant attachment style? Or perhaps because of those things that happened in middle school?—I am not entirely sure if I am a person full of love. Because back then, not even she (my mom) had love for me (at least, none that I could feel at the time), so how could I dare to believe in the love of others?

I have partially validated some of the things Sinya wrote through my own lived experiences, which has involuntarily led me to trust his other viewpoints as well.

Why on earth am I leaving this blog behind, anyway? I just wanted to write something, that’s all—to listen to the void where not even an echo exists.

As for how you all might view me after seeing all these words and thoughts of mine—do I really need to care? What requires my caring (the cost needed to maintain human relationships) consequently (makes me) no longer need to care (about the relationship).

Come to think of it, I seem to have read The World as Will and Representation many times back in high school, yet I’ve almost completely forgotten the philosophical principles within it. As a result, I can no longer quite understand the related theories mentioned in a few of my own posts now.

I used to love eating ham sausages when I was a kid, so lately I’ve been fulfilling that childhood dream once a day, and it brings me a great sense of happiness.

All that is of this world is not eternal; all that is eternal is not of this world.

All that is not of this world is eternal; all that is not eternal is of this world.

‘Your “forgetting” is physiological, your “guilt” is emotional, while her “indifference” is of the truth.’—I find it truly incredible that an AI could predict a sentence like this. Just as the line, “Gossamer metes out the dust of a hundred years,” rivals the works of the ancients in every way.

All in all, Sinya is a sincere person.

I also consider myself a sincere person. But this is far, far, far, far from enough.

Perhaps I need to write a bit more? Yet why do I feel even emptier after finishing?

entry.title: 2025 ICPC Nanjing Travelogue
entry.content:
2025 ICPC Nanjing Travelogue

Day -1

For some reason, I’ve been particularly fond of Jay Chou’s early songs lately, namely the কয়েকজন albums before '05, even though I used to prefer his songs from '06 to '10. They’re about the same age as me now. I feel these old-school songs have a faint yet mellow sadness to them, whereas his new songs in recent years are a bit exaggerated and frivolous. Among the old songs, Sunny Day is the most classic. For the first few years after I got to know him in middle school, I didn’t find it all that stunning, yet now I have become the very person in the melody.

My body felt terrible all morning, an indescribable discomfort, probably just too exhausted from the vp last night. Still, I’m currently planning to do a CF round tonight.

Day 0

November 7th, 2 AM, Hangzhou, clear skies. My heart feels so calm.

As long as I get a >=+40 rating change, I’m pretty happy, and I achieved that goal tonight. Even though E was far less difficult than I imagined—dXqwq even coded it up in five minutes. Apparently you just run a DSU based on the degrees and calculate a bit. Turns out it was neither a Kruskal reconstruction tree nor an Eulerian path… My mind even wandered to Prim’s algorithm.

I suppose I’ve realized once again that there are hard things in this world: inverted delusions. 99% of things are hard, the missing tools in 99% of ideas cannot be realized, and 99% of approaches cannot guarantee correctness.

Only that tiny fraction of things is doable. What we can do, and need to do, is by no means accomplishing the impossible, but merely finding what can be done; once found, it is naturally accomplished. Or rather, what we need is to realize that we are trying to do the impossible and immediately abandon the attempt—and sometimes, to stop this self-deception.

This requires rapid and constant self-subversion in one’s thinking.

Anyway, the late-night snack was delicious.

Where there is a will, there is a way. This saying is completely wrong. Only things that conform to scientific laws can succeed. Most of the things people want to do, no matter how hard they try, cannot succeed. What we must do is eliminate the ninety-nine things that cannot succeed out of a hundred, and find that single one that can. This is hard, but we must do it!
—— Supernova Era

It’s evening now. Just took a shower, and for some reason, I feel very excited. At least more excited than I was for the two regionals last year.

Day 1

Coach Han gave us a lot of advice last night. The night before, I transcribed the coach’s words, printed out a copy of Precautions and Methodology, and brought it to the contest venue on both days. Right now it should be sitting at our seats in the training team’s classroom.

Woke up past seven in the morning. Went downstairs, divided the luggage with my teammates, and took a cab to the East Station. After arriving at noon, we found the hotel was right near the subway station, very close. There was a weird smell in the room, but it was fine—after all, it was a single room for myself, much better than the dorm environment…

Checked in, picked up the supplies, took group photos. Personally, I think the Nanjing site uniforms look really nice. Too bad we went late and the prizes for the trivia quiz were all gone.

Speaking of which, I still haven’t seen my brother the whole time, sigh.

When the practice session started, lyc pressed F4 and sent the computer into tty mode, though it recovered after a reboot with the help of a volunteer.

Today is lyc’s birthday! fpy, I, and his old friends had a meal of claypot chicken together, and ate cake too~ It tasted really good~ Plus it was my first time trying it, and the portions were huge~

Boohoo, having friends to celebrate your birthday with is truly so wonderful! Right then and there, I secretly made up my mind that I must invite her to my birthday next week.

Day 2

I think we left the hotel a bit past eight.

F

Right from the start, the first problem I looked at was F. The problem statement was very short, and after reading it I immediately realized this was definitely a doable problem, and very likely to be solved early on. But that’s when my agony began, because I didn’t have any immediate ideas—especially for problems like this involving dynamic graphs, online queries, connectivity, and such; I felt like I had almost never encountered an easy one of this kind. It also involved bitwise operations. So I started praying that I was just underestimating the difficulty of this problem.

But the most agonizing part was that jiangly solved this problem at the 8-minute mark!

As a result, this problem showed up on the board as an easy problem. Since it’s an easy problem, and jiangly coded it up in such a short amount of time, how could the solution possibly be building 4096 DSUs…? From then on, I was constantly wavering between two trains of thought: “There must be a simpler way!” and “Maybe this problem really is quite complicated?”, going around in circles endlessly.

First, I tried an approach of building 12 DSUs bit by bit, but it couldn’t handle multiple edges at all, because multiple edges would require undoing the connectivity of lower-level nodes. At the time, fpy talked me out of it, saying that a rollback DSU would make it at least a black-rated problem, which was unlikely—and that was indeed true. This approach was something like O(12qα(n))O(12q\alpha(n))O(12qα(n)). The complexity was fine, but the correctness wasn’t. By the time I submitted it, the clock had already reached 3:09:01.

Then I tried an approach that enumerates subsets: for the weight of a newly added edge, enumerate all of its subsets, then connect the DSUs corresponding to those subsets, and for queries, just check all of them. Correctness was absolutely guaranteed, but the complexity wasn’t—it was O((2popcount(w)+212)qα(n))O\left(\left(2^{popcount\left(w\right)}+2^{12}\right)q\alpha(n)\right)O((2popcount(w)+212)qα(n)). The time reached 4:29:53.

And with that, Problem F completely collapsed. Affected by F, I barely looked at any other problems the entire time.

After the scoreboard froze, I tried an approach where for a newly added edge weight, I only enumerated its distinct binary suffixes. I remember it couldn’t even pass the sample cases at first, and only passed after I added something or other—I can’t remember what. The time reached 4:55:00.

K

Next, let’s talk about K. A Chinese chess problem asking whether there exists a strategy such that the chariot is guaranteed to capture the horse. All I can say is that it’s a trivial one-glance problem: if the horse still can’t escape after making one move, then it will definitely be captured. You just enumerate the eight directions and check.

I remember lyc seemed to be looking at this problem right from the start, but he kept being unsure whether the conclusion above was correct? After I finished writing C and assured him that the conclusion was right, he went ahead to code it, I think. But he actually wrote a dfs that returns when dep==2, which was pretty hard not to laugh at. Since it was a gimme problem, he seemed to spend quite a long time debugging it. So after sorting out the implementation details, I kicked him off the keyboard and went to code it myself. Felt pretty fast, finished it in a dozen lines or so, though I also spent a little while debugging. The time reached 00:59:44.

fpy seemed to be looking at the earlier kangaroo problem at first, though he quickly switched to F later on as well, and was trying hard the whole time to communicate with me about approaches for F. But I was a bit anxious at the time—my head was both completely empty and completely full, and I just couldn’t take anything in.

Problem C was also handed to me by fpy. He said it was super obvious at the time. I took a look, and indeed: an even number can always be split in half, and an odd number can never equal an even number times an odd number. And just like that, it was done.

G

Of course, in the end, we were redeemed by lyc. Thank you LYC! He solved Problem G at 3:48:02, saving us from the doom of striking iron. Actually, by this point, even if we had solved F, we wouldn’t have gotten a silver medal anyway. We only realized this after the contest ended.

He said Problem G was very simple. Seems like he got a WA at first because of some bound issue. I don’t know, I was out of it the entire time.

After solving G, lyc also gave me an approach for Problem I. The problem seemed to be about finding ppap. He said to enumerate two boundaries in O(n2)O\left(n^2\right)O(n2), use KMP to calculate the boundaries, and then enumerate the inside once more and just keep a count. Since I usually code faster, he tried explaining it to me several times so I could write it, though I didn’t really understand it in the end. Later he also realized the first part was actually O(n3)O\left(n^3\right)O(n3), so it wouldn’t work.

Afterwards, lyc told me that Problem I might have been more promising than Problem F. Problem F was seriously such a trap.

After it ended, I stuffed the little kangaroo into my pocket and hurried off to Nanjing South Station without staying for the awards ceremony.,

After

Depressed? Depressed. Very depressed, terribly depressed. Yet there’s also a sense of relief. Maybe I won’t obsess over rating as much when I play cf in the future.

Retiring? Seems like four people have asked me if I’m going to retire. How do I put it? I don’t know. Even though it’s already the 18th now, I still don’t know. I feel like there’s a damn high chance I’ll be persuaded to quit by the coach, what do I do…

Speaking of being persuaded to quit, while chatting on the road afterwards, fpy said that hyl was persuaded to quit by the coach back then because she was stuck at green for two years. What kind of rumor is this? I always thought she quit on her own because she didn’t perform well in the HDU Spring camp. Sigh, after all, her performance in the 2024 freshman contest was really dazzling.

However, I still believe that hyl did the wrong thing. Because at the time her actions were closely tied to my own interests, and due to other factors, I have far, far too many reasons not to forgive her.

Come to think of it, there’s a relatively high chance lyc will retire, while my personal guess is that fpy probably won’t.

Speaking of which, I don’t even want to upsolve the problems from this contest—gives me a bit of PTSD, so to speak. Of course, there will be chances to upsolve them later.

The contest result really does conform quite well to scientific laws, doesn’t it? In the weeks before the contest, we vp’d at least five CCPC and ICPC regionals, and except for getting silver in the Hong Kong site, every single one of them was a bronze medal, without exception. Doesn’t that say it all? Overperforming would be what violates science.

(On a side note, that RainbowChicken place near the Wisteria Garden Hotel at Cuipingshan Subway Station is seriously delicious! The portions are super generous too! And it’s really cheap! If I get the chance next time, I’m definitely ordering it again! It’s seriously so good!)

Day 4

Pretty good luck—I played codeforces and solved a relatively simple D1, which was the kind of mex problem I like, and successfully reached purple at 1959, fulfilling a long-cherished wish of over 500 days! Actually, during that cf round on Day -1, I already had a strong premonition that I would reach purple very soon, as if this premonition were forcefully pushing my rating up, refusing to let me say no. But why didn’t this premonition help me perform well at the regional contest?

I feel like it was precisely this slightly carefree, slacking-off mindset after failing to secure a silver medal that actually made me perform better.

entry.title: Poetry
entry.content:
Simply arranging words at will is enough
The flowers silently look up at the sun, the latter stretching out its rays, wearing a faint smile.
On the plains lies an endless expanse of green grass.
Holding a green umbrella, I walk slowly amidst this expanse of green.
With no one around to disturb me, I can freely imagine my imaginations, I can create everything I desire out of nothingness.
The sun is gradually hidden away, pale gray clouds slowly gather, and the sky looks as if it is about to weep……
Deprived of the golden light reflecting off its blades, the green grass, too, loses its vitality……

The rain patters softly, dripping drop by drop onto the umbrella, and sliding off drop by drop.
Suddenly, I see a golden light bloom from a raindrop, as if she has opened her own eyes, majesty and innocence coexisting, passion and coldness harbored together, gazing at this gloomy heaven and earth, gazing at the gloomy me.
She stops falling, and flies up toward the sky, everywhere she passes, countless water droplets seem to radiate with new life, and the golden light in her eyes is that very newborn life.
Soon, everything between heaven and earth is flooded with the golden hue emanating from the rain, how pale that color is… how tender… not scorching, but soothing this lost world……
Just as you comfort me.

I close the storybook, and you have already fallen asleep. Your even breathing is like a graceful melody, and I listen in a daze. If Chopin were here, this rhythm would be elevated into a work surpassing the Nocturnes.
